## Welcome

I am a Process Transformation Engineer with more than seven years of experience leading process improvement, workflow automation, operational transformation, and data-driven decision-making initiatives across banking, technology, and service organizations.

My expertise spans business process reengineering, automation strategy, process governance, analytics, and technology enablement. I have partnered with business and technology teams to streamline operations, improve controls, strengthen compliance, and deliver scalable solutions that enhance efficiency and customer experience.

In addition to my professional experience, I explore practical applications of artificial intelligence, data analytics, and automation technologies. Through personal projects, I develop analytical solutions using SQL, R, PostgreSQL, and locally hosted large language models (LLMs) to support knowledge management, information retrieval, and business insights.

This website highlights selected projects, technical work, and areas of professional interest related to process transformation, analytics, automation, and AI.
